c74object.name: el.clean_selector~
c74object.digest: Multi-channel signal selector with smooth crossfading
c74object.description:
el.clean_selector~ selects between multiple incoming audio signals and routes the chosen input to a single output with click-free equal-power or linear crossfading. Unlike MSP's standard selector~, signal inputs are 0-indexed starting at the leftmost inlet (Inlet 0), which functions as both audio Input 0 and the channel selection inlet.
Inlets
Inlet 1 [Left Inlet] (signal / int / float): Audio Input 0 and Channel Select. Accepts numbers (int, float, channel) from 0 to N-1 to choose the active signal input, as well as the audio signal for input channel 0.
Inlets 2 to N (signal): Audio Inputs 1 to N-1 (total inlets determined by the first argument, default: 8).
Outlets
Outlet 1 (signal): Selected audio output. Crossfades smoothly to newly selected audio inputs without clicks.

inlet.description: Receives audio Input 0 as well as channel selection control messages (int, float, or channel). Channel indexing starts at 0.
Audio input signals (numbered 1 up to N-1).

outlet.description: The currently selected incoming audio signal.

objarg.name: signal-count
objarg.description: The number of signal inputs to create (default: 8, range: 2 to 64).

objarg.name: crossfade-duration
objarg.description: Crossfade duration in milliseconds applied when switching between active inputs (default: 50.0 ms).

method.name: channel
method.description: Selects which input channel (0 to N-1) to route to the output. Triggers an equal-power or linear crossfade from the previous channel.

method.name: fadetime
method.description: Sets the crossfade duration in milliseconds (clamped to 0.1 – 1,000,000 ms).

method.name: float
method.description: Float received in the leftmost inlet selects the active input channel (truncated to integer, range 0 to N-1).

method.name: int
method.description: Integer received in the leftmost inlet selects the active input channel (range 0 to N-1).

method.name: linear
method.description: When set to 1, crossfading between input channels uses a linear amplitude ramp. When set to 0 (default), equal-power (sine/cosine) crossfading is used.

method.name: signal
method.description: Audio signals to be switched and crossfaded. Note that inlet 0 accepts audio signal Input 0 as well as control messages.
